title: Plakar Home Assistant Exporter Connector Config

token.description: Long-lived access token of an administrator, read from PLAKAR_HOMEASSISTANT_TOKEN when omitted

agent.description: Backup agent to upload to, the local one (backup.local or hassio.local) when omitted

password.description: Password of the backup, needed to restore members that were encrypted when imported

restore.description: Have the instance restore the backup once uploaded, which restarts it
